notes.title: New title from RedDeerGames! 7 Horizons is coming to Steam! Wishlist NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37794046/186127bcf106c0d351f479795dbc29068e4a560b.png[/img]
[h1]A hero needed now - the adventure begins after the first shot![/h1]

Exciting platform challenges with shooter elements - all with a comic book atmosphere, humor, and beautiful hand-drawn graphics - that's [b]7 Horizons! [/b]

[h1]Discover a cosmic world![/h1]

For thousands of years, the[b] Six Worlds [/b]coexisted in harmony with each other. They were bound together by a mysterious energy, [b]the Essence[/b], which took a different form on each planet. 

However, the balance was disturbed by the arrival of [b]Distortion[/b], a mysterious creature the size of a globe, under whose influence the beings living in the Six Worlds began to change…

[h1]Rayman meets Mega Man![/h1]

You play as Jelly, who, as his name suggests, is a jelly that can change its shape. Thanks to this ability, you can take on the form and skills of people you meet. 

The game is maintained in a comic book style, which with the addition of a huge portion of humor, creates a world in which you will be a superhero in a cosmic epic!

In 7 Horizons you will visit many planets, each one providing a new experience with its unique mechanics and design.


[h3]So only one question remains - will you accept the challenge?[/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1628420/7_Horizons/]Visit 7 Horizons on Steam and add it to your Wishlist![/url][/h2]
